Fun fact: Family Matters was meant to be a 600 hour long epic drama to be run on the 4th of July weekend. It would have broken box office records and been the top grossing movie with an all black cast of all time, but it had troubles in distribution because few theaters were willing to staff their buildings for the full length of the movie. Not wanting to go home with nothing, the movie studio chopped the film up into half-hour segments regardless of how it affected the coherent overarching plot, added a laugh track at random points, and sold the rights to ABC to run as a sitcom.

Few people have ever seen the original director’s cut of the movie, but those who have rank it as one of the greatest dramas of all time.
